title: A Aftermath for the Glasshouse
author: Sable Ashgrove
blurb: Casper Underhill, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
